summary: The PR adds the `store_cv_values` parameter to `RidgeClassifierCV`, which resolves the reported issue. The change is minimal and well-documented.

issues.description: The parameter name `store_cv_values` does not match the naming convention used in other parts of the codebase (e.g., `store_cv_values_`).
The docstring for `RidgeClassifierCV` could be updated to include a description of the `store_cv_values` parameter.
